title: Automatically tune power settings with powertop
summary: Apply optimal power-saving settings to your system automatically. This can help extend battery life on laptops.

steps.explain: Run powertop with the --auto-tune flag to apply recommended power-saving settings. This requires root privileges.

rollback.explain: Reboot the system to revert power settings to defaults if issues occur.

warnings: This changes system power settings. If your system becomes unstable or peripherals stop working, reboot to revert.
